findings.title: Erez Crossing opens for inspection of Gaza aid trucks for first time since February 2025
findings.location: Erez Crossing, northern Gaza Strip; onward truck movement planned to Kerem Shalom Crossing, southern Gaza Strip
findings.affected_population_or_system: Humanitarian aid cargo inspection and crossing logistics. Israeli security source says Erez restarted cargo-truck screening, not direct entry of aid into Gaza; a few dozen trucks planned to undergo checks before onward routing through Kerem Shalom. Actual throughput and aid delivery not independently confirmed.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: The Erez Crossing in the northern Gaza Strip reopened this morning for the inspection of aid trucks only
findings.source_type: Established Israeli news outlet, first-hand reporting attributed to an unnamed security source; no independent official verification located

discovery_context.first_seen: Recovered in this watch from a targeted crossing search; article dated 18 November 09:22 Israel local (17 November 23:22 PST), predating the immediately previous heartbeat, so this is late-recalled reporting rather than an event first reported during the current watch.
discovery_context.novelty: Specific reported resumption of Erez cargo inspections using a donated German scanner is absent from preceding authenticated 23:48 PST heartbeat. OCHA 16 November access/movement item predates alleged reopening.
discovery_context.limitations: Single established outlet quoting an unnamed Israeli security source. Crossing is reported open for inspection only; trucks are supposed to enter Gaza through Kerem Shalom. No independently verified truck transit count, admission or delivery. Event time described only as 'this morning'.
